# langsmith_run_rules (Data Source)

Lists LangSmith automation (run) rules, with optional filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "langsmith_run_rules" "all" {}

data "langsmith_run_rules" "session_rules" {
  type = "session"
}

output "rule_names" {
  value = [for r in data.langsmith_run_rules.all.rules : r.display_name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `dataset_id` (String) Filter to rules attached to this dataset ID.
- `name_contains` (String) Filter to rules whose display name contains this substring.
- `session_id` (String) Filter to rules attached to this project/session ID.
- `type` (String) Filter by rule type. Valid values: `session`, `dataset`.
- `workspace_id` (String) If set, overrides the provider-level `workspace_id` for all API calls made by this data source.

### Read-Only

- `rules` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))
